mapapi.description: Map backend: 'leaflet' (default, OpenStreetMap), 'google' (requires API key), or legacy 'gmap' alias.

displaycolor.description: Use <color> tags from GPX file for track/route coloring if present.

trackmarker.description: Show directional markers along track segments (Leaflet-only).

routemarker.description: Show directional markers along route segments (Leaflet-only).

linktarget.description: Target for links embedded in GPX elements: '_self', '_blank', or '_popup'.

tracks_verbinden.description: Concatenate multiple tracks in graphs so distance/time axes are continuous.

showdesc.description: Include the <desc> field in waypoint popups (in addition to <name> and <cmt>).

smooth_elevation_window.description: Window size for elevation smoothing (must be odd positive integer).

cluster_distance.description: Maximum distance in meters between waypoints to form a cluster.

map_type.description: Initial map type. Leaflet options: 'OSM', 'OSMDE', 'OSM_Cycle', 'OSM_Landscape', 'OSM_Outdoors', 'Open_Topo', 'TopPlusOpen', 'Open_Sea', 'Hiking', 'Cycling', 'Keine_Karte'. Google options: 'Satellit', 'Hybrid', 'Oberflaeche'.

api_keys.description: API keys required for certain maps. Supported keys: 'mapbox' (for OSM_Cycle/Landscape), 'thunderforest' (for some OSM variants), 'google' (for Google Maps API).

profile_fields.description: Additional fields to include in graphs: 'elevation', 'speed', 'cadence', 'heartrate', 'airtemp', 'power'.
